# Wattpad
> Wattpad is a global social storytelling platform where readers and writers discover, publish, and discuss stories across every genre.

Wattpad combines serialized fiction, community interaction, and creator programs into a social reading experience. Readers can browse trending stories, fanfiction, and genre collections, while writers can publish chapters, build audiences, and participate in programs and contests.

## Main Platform
- [Homepage](https://www.wattpad.com/): Main entry point for discovering stories, genres, and community features.
- [Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories): Browse stories across popular genres, trends, and reader interests.
- [Create](https://www.wattpad.com/create): Start writing and publishing a new story on Wattpad.
- [Write](https://www.wattpad.com/write): Access Wattpad’s writing and publishing tools for authors.
- [Search](https://www.wattpad.com/search): Search for stories, authors, reading lists, and tags.
- [Community](https://www.wattpad.com/community): Explore community spaces and social engagement around stories.

## Reading and Discovery
- [Romance Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/romance): Discover romance stories from emerging and established writers.
- [Fanfiction Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/fanfiction): Browse fanfiction inspired by popular fandoms, characters, and universes.
- [Fantasy Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/fantasy): Explore fantasy stories featuring magic, quests, and imagined worlds.
- [Mystery Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/mystery): Find mystery stories centered on suspense, secrets, and investigation.
- [Paranormal Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/paranormal): Read paranormal fiction with supernatural themes and creatures.
- [Science Fiction Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/science-fiction): Discover science fiction stories about future worlds and technology.
- [Teen Fiction Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/teen-fiction): Browse teen fiction focused on school, identity, and relationships.
- [Werewolf Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/stories/werewolf): Explore one of Wattpad’s most popular trope-driven story categories.

## Writers and Publishing
- [Writer Opportunities](https://www.wattpad.com/writers): Overview of resources and opportunities for writers on Wattpad.
- [Creator Programs](https://www.wattpad.com/creators): Learn about programs designed to support and grow writers.
- [Paid Stories](https://www.wattpad.com/paidstories): Premium stories available through Wattpad’s monetization program.
- [Wattpad Originals](https://www.wattpad.com/originals): Curated original stories and featured premium content.
- [Brand Partnerships](https://www.wattpad.com/brand-partnerships): Information about branded storytelling and audience engagement opportunities.
- [Studios](https://www.wattpadstudios.com/): Wattpad Studios adapts stories for film, television, and other media.

## Community and Engagement
- [The Wattys](https://www.wattpad.com/thewattys): Wattpad’s flagship awards program recognizing standout writers and stories.
- [Ambassadors](https://www.wattpad.com/ambassadors): Community volunteer program supporting readers and writers on the platform.
- [Clubs](https://www.wattpad.com/clubs): Join interest-based groups for discussion, feedback, and community participation.
- [Reading Lists](https://www.wattpad.com/readinglists): Explore curated reading lists created by users and Wattpad.
- [Newsroom](https://company.wattpad.com/blog): Updates, announcements, and company news from Wattpad.
- [Community Guidelines](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/200774334): Rules and expectations for participating on Wattpad.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us): Central support portal for readers, writers, and account issues.
- [Wattpad Basics](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/200056334): Learn core platform features and how Wattpad works.
- [Account and Profile](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/200056344): Help with account settings, profiles, and login-related issues.
- [Reading and Library](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/200056354): Support for reading features, libraries, and story access.
- [Writing and Publishing](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/200056364): Guidance for drafting, posting, and managing stories.
- [Trust and Safety](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/200056374): Safety, reporting, moderation, and policy-related support.
- [Paid Stories Support](https://support.wattpad.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001273211): Help for premium story purchases and monetized content.

- [Careers](https://company.wattpad.com/jobs): Explore job opportunities and working at Wattpad.
- [Press](https://company.wattpad.com/press): Press resources and media information about Wattpad.

- [Contact](https://company.wattpad.com/contact): Contact information for business and media inquiries.
- [Wattpad Brand Guidelines](https://company.wattpad.com/brand-guidelines): Official branding assets and usage guidance.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://policies.wattpad.com/terms/): Terms governing use of Wattpad’s platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://policies.wattpad.com/privacy/): Details on data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Content Guidelines](https://policies.wattpad.com/content-guidelines/): Rules for acceptable story content and platform moderation.
- [Copyright Policy](https://policies.wattpad.com/copyright/): Copyright reporting and intellectual property policy.
- [Payments Terms](https://policies.wattpad.com/payments-terms/): Terms related to purchases, payments, and monetized features.
- [Accessibility](https://policies.wattpad.com/accessibility/): Accessibility commitments and information for Wattpad services.

## Mobile Apps
- [Wattpad on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=wp.wattpad): Android app for reading, writing, and engaging with stories.
- [Wattpad on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/wattpad/id306310789): iOS app for discovering and reading Wattpad stories.
- [Download Wattpad](https://www.wattpad.com/getmobile): Official mobile app download page for supported devices.
